content: sessionStorage is partitioned by both origin and browser tabs (top-level browsing contexts). The data in sessionStorage is only kept for the duration of the page session. A page session lasts as long as the tab or the browser is open, and survives over page reloads and restores. Closing the tab/window ends the session and clears data in sessionStorage.
conclusion: MDN官方规范明确sessionStorage生命周期仅绑定于当前浏览器标签页或窗口（page session），页面刷新可保留，但关闭标签页或窗口即被清除，且跨标签页不共享；草稿暂存不能承诺跨窗口关闭必能恢复。
